name: MyPlugin
description: Fab-aware DRC (Lion Circuits), V/A net sizing, datasheet-style Copper Paths, pours + ViaStitcher, H/V autoroute, PcbDraw docs, live FreeCAD link.
description_full:
One toolbar button opens a hub with twelve tools: Fab Rules (Lion Circuits DRC), Net Setup (IPC-2221 widths, netclasses, DRC rules), Power Trace, Copper Path (wide copper that follows a net's traces, keeps clearance, refresh after dragging), Power Pours, Via Stitching (bundled ViaStitcher by weirdgyn, MIT), Autoroute H/V (Freerouting, never shrinks traces), Silk Beautify, Docs (PcbDraw drawings + renders), FreeCAD (StepUp) live link both ways without restarting either app, 3D Models for Eagle imports, and Eagle -> KiCad symbol swap with netlist check.

All output is written next to the board. Optional: Java 21 + freerouting.jar (autoroute), PcbDraw (installed on first use), FreeCAD + KiCad StepUp (installed on first use).
